execution.entry_logic: Production ioc_limit at the decision-bar close. A candidate is admitted only when stop distance is at most 400 ticks and reward-to-risk is at least 1.0. Fills that land outside the bracket are invalid-at-fill and are counted separately, never as P&L.
execution.exit_logic: Static documented bracket. No runner and no breakeven adjustment.
execution.stop_logic: Strategy stop, capped at 400 ticks ($200) per contract. A wider structural stop is not admitted.
execution.target_logic: The strategy target already on the candidate. Reward-to-risk below 1.0 is not admitted.
execution.sizing: One MNQ contract. Isolated ledger starting balance $4,000. Daily-loss floor for this ledger is $200 so one capped loss does not halt the day by the $150 floor.
execution.friction: One adverse tick on entry. Round-turn cost $1.48, matching the historical bracket net.

acceptance_criteria: top-three-month share of net under 60 percent
rejection_criteria: net P&L not positive at the stopping point
top-three-month share of net 60 percent or more
